sentences.text: In a small village, there was an old house.
The house was dark and big.
It had many windows, but they were always closed.
The villagers said it was haunted.
They told stories of ghosts and spirits.
No one wanted to go near the house.
One day, a girl named Lily moved to the village.
She heard the stories about the old house.
She wanted to know if the stories were true.
The sky was orange and red.
The house looked even scarier in the dark.
The door was old and creaked when she opened it.
Inside, it was cold and quiet.
She felt a chill in the air.
There were old pictures on the walls.
The faces in the pictures seemed to watch her.
"Lily... Lily..." It was soft and sad.
She turned around, but no one was there.
She wanted to leave, but her feet would not move.
It led her to a dark room at the end of the hall.
It was a girl, about her age.
"How can I help you?" she asked.
Anna pointed to a dusty old mirror.
Breaking the mirror could be dangerous.
But she wanted to help Anna.
She picked up a heavy chair.
With all her strength, she threw it at the mirror.
A bright light filled the room.
Lily felt a warmth in her heart.
Lily left the house, feeling brave and happy.
The villagers would no longer fear the old house.
From that day, Lily became a hero in the village.
She showed everyone that sometimes, ghosts just need help to find peace.
